title: By two months a baby can follow a moving object across a wide arc
summary: MedlinePlus says that by two months an infant can track a moving object up to 180 degrees and prefers faces.
body: In the sensory section of its newborn-development page, MedlinePlus says that by two months an infant can track moving objects up to 180 degrees, and prefers faces. The page was reviewed on 1 January 2025. The line is broader than a brief glance at a toy, and it is an encyclopedia summary rather than a pass-fail screening result for one child.

sources.title: Infant - newborn development

sources.note: Supports tracking moving objects up to 180 degrees by two months, and a preference for faces.
